evidence.excerpt: We introduce \bench{}, a benchmark that contrasts authorization evidence for the same operation in its language track.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: As language-model agents write code, move money and change records on behalf of users, deciding whether an action is authorized has become a central safety problem.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: It combines expert-annotated natural-language scenarios with executed and verified operations, plus externally sourced native-policy requests. \bench{} checks each decision for correctness, usability and resulting effect, and tracks each request across guardrail changes.
